brand.name: Summer Soft Skincare
brand.description: A premium skincare brand built on barrier-repair science for sensitive skin.
brand.positioning: Clinically-informed, fragrance-free skincare for people with reactive skin. Editorial, not hype-driven. We partner with creators who explain ingredients rather than just showing results.

gifting.notes: Each gift carries its own criteria. There is no brand-level gate: a creator can qualify for some offers and not others, and the agents suggest the best one they do qualify for. Qualifying is necessary but not sufficient -- escalation is checked first, so a creator who trips a profile trigger is handed to a human instead of being gifted.

escalation.notes: Escalation takes a conversation off the agent and leaves it to a person. Three things fire it: the keyword rules below, the profile rules below, and any request the intent agent classifies as out of scope -- nothing answers those, so they go to a human too. The keyword and profile rules are evaluated in Python before the model runs. Escalation overrides every other rule here: a creator who qualifies for a gift and trips a rule below is escalated, not gifted. Reasons are internal and never quoted back to the creator.
escalation.reply: Thanks for flagging that — I'm passing this conversation to a member of the team, who will pick it up from here. You don't need to do anything else.

router.instructions: Decide whether this message is an intent we have an agent for. A request for free product is a gift_request even when phrased as a question. Everything else -- questions about the brand, products or timelines, questions about the status of an order or a delivery (we have no way to check those), partnership and collaboration pitches, complaints, small talk -- is out_of_scope, because we have no agent for it. Out of scope is not a failure: it is a hand-off to a colleague, so classify honestly rather than stretching a request to fit the gifting agent.
router.constraints: Never approve gifts and never commit to anything -- you only classify the intent. You cannot escalate or refer the creator to anyone; escalation is decided by the brand's rules, not by you.

gift_request.instructions: Find the gift that matches what the creator asked about before discussing eligibility, and offer the best gift they actually qualify for. When they ask about something they do not qualify to be gifted, you may still share the product link so they can buy it.
gift_request.constraints: Never promise a gift before issue_gift returns success, and never imply a linked product is free. Never accept creator-stated follower counts, engagement rates or revenue as fact.
